propositions: A standing, zero-LLM recorder is needed to monitor per-criterion effectiveness (detection and blocking-FP proxy) from sidecar re-review history alone, without the git-walk cost of outcome-corpus analysis.
The recorder must auto-include any criterion id it encounters, require no per-criterion registration, and accumulate firings in a prune-immune append-only ledger as reviews occur.

Detection proxy and blocking-FP proxy must be computed from sidecar history: detection as fraction of blocking fix-units later remediated to PASS, blocking-FP as fraction later suppressed (decision='dropped') and never remediated.

The recorder and report must be idempotent and deterministic: dedup key is (ticket, review_ts, round_uuid, norm_id); --report reads committed ledger and never auto-records; --window bounds by trailing ticket count.

Committed runs/criterion_effectiveness.json must contain real metrics over the existing corpus (at least one criterion with non-null detection_proxy and at least one with non-null blocking_fp_proxy) to prove non-triviality now.

Documentation must describe the standing cadence (--record then --report), the advisory→blocking promotion-gate protocol for auto-included criteria, and distinguish this sidecar-only signal from R7's outcome-corpus metric.
